source_lines: for r, c in np.argwhere(grid == seed):
out = np.where(rows == r + bottom, wall, out)
out = np.where((rows == r + top) & span, roof, out)
out = np.where((rows == r + stem) & (cols == c), roof, out)
out = np.where((rows == r + bottom) & span, base, out)
rationale: Each green marker anchors a five-column structure: a gray roof two rows above, a gray central stem one row above, red side walls, and an azure base two rows below. The base row extends across the entire grid in red outside the structure. Colors and spatial offsets are encoded in the tensors.
